out_items.name: Certified Food Protection Manager
Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Employee Health Policy in Place
violations.observation: Upon discussion with the person-in-charge, one or more of the elements of an effective employee health policy is either missing or incomplete. A complete employee health policy is required to be in place at the food establishment. At the time of this inspection, the Health Department provided and reviewed handouts and resource information in a red folder labeled 'Employee Health Policy.' STAFF ONSITE UNABLE TO PROVIDE EMPLOYEE HEALTH POLICIES.
violations.corrective_action: A complete employee health policy must have the following elements: 1) Employee training on foodborne illness, particularly symptoms of illness and prevention of the Big Six illnesses (see 'What is Foodborne Illness' handout); and 2) Documentation that employees have been instructed of their responsibility to report symptoms of, diagnosis of or exposure to foodborne illness to management (see 'Employee Illness Reporting Agreement' handout); and 3) A management plan to restrict or exclude employees, as applicable, who have symptoms, diagnosis or exposure to foodborne illness (see 'Employee Illness Decision Guide for PIC/CFM' handout). The information provided at the time of this inspection will help you develop and implement this policy. Handouts are available in the following languages: English, Arabic, Chinese (traditional), Farsi, Hindi, Korean, Spanish, Thai, Urdu and Vietnamese. If you have any questions about your employee health policy, please contact your area inspector or contact the Health Department at 703-246-2201, TTY 703-591-6435. CDI: POLICY PROVIDED VIA EMAIL. EVERY EMPLOYEE MUST SIGN ONE AND THEY MUST BE KEPT ONSITE FOR REVIEW AT ALL TIMES.

out_items.name: Food-contact surfaces cleaned and sanitized

violations.title: Food Contact Surfaces Clean to Sight & Touch
violations.observation: The following equipment/utensils were observed soiled to sight and touch: OBSERVED SIGNIFICANT DEBRIS BUILD-UP ON PLASTIC DOUGH CONTAINERS. OBSERVED SINGLE-USE UTENSILS TO BE VISIBLY SOILED IN A BOX AT THE COOKLINE.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be clean to the sight and touch. A surface that is soiled cannot be effectively sanitized. CDI: PIC BEGAN WASHING PLASTIC DOUGH CONTAINERS. SINGLE-USE UTENSILS DISPOSED OF.

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED TURKEY BACON LEFT OUT FOR 2HRS AT 52F ON THE THREE-VAT SINK.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI: TURKEY BACON PUT IN COOLER. PIC RE-EDUCATED.

out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Employee Health Policy in Place
violations.observation: Upon discussion with the person-in-charge, one or more of the elements of an effective employee health policy is either missing or incomplete. A complete employee health policy is required to be in place at the food establishment. At the time of this inspection, the Health Department provided and reviewed handouts and resource information in a red folder labeled 'Employee Health Policy.' Employees on shift during time of inspection did not have an employee health policy that has been read agreed too and signed
violations.corrective_action: A complete employee health policy must have the following elements: 1) Employee training on foodborne illness, particularly symptoms of illness and prevention of the Big Six illnesses (see 'What is Foodborne Illness' handout); and 2) Documentation that employees have been instructed of their responsibility to report symptoms of, diagnosis of or exposure to foodborne illness to management (see 'Employee Illness Reporting Agreement' handout); and 3) A management plan to restrict or exclude employees, as applicable, who have symptoms, diagnosis or exposure to foodborne illness (see 'Employee Illness Decision Guide for PIC/CFM' handout). The information provided at the time of this inspection will help you develop and implement this policy. Handouts are available in the following languages: English, Arabic, Chinese (traditional), Farsi, Hindi, Korean, Spanish, Thai, Urdu and Vietnamese. If you have any questions about your employee health policy, please contact your area inspector or contact the Health Department at 703-246-2201, TTY 703-591-6435. Person in charge agreed to print another employee health policy and have the person read agreed to and sign the policy. Will verify compliance tomorrow

out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: observed raw chicken being stored on top of dough pizza dough in trays
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. person in charge moved the raw chicken so it was no longer on top of RTE foods

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: Time as a Public Health Control, Written Procedures
violations.observation: The person in charge is not able to provide written procedures for the use of time as a public health control with the following time/temperature control for safety food item(s): observed establishment using time as a public health control for breading flour used for raw chicken without having written procedures established
violations.corrective_action: If time only is used as a public health control for a working supply of time/temperature control for safety food before cooking or for ready to eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that is displayed or held for service for immediate consumption, written procedures shall be prepared in advance and maintained in the food establishment and made available to the regulatory authority upon request. Person in charge discarded flour, will set up written procedures for using time as A public health control and verify compliance with EHS tommorrrow

out_items.name: Thermometers provided and accurate

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold or hot holding equipment: 2 door prep top cooler for sandwiches and 3 door prep top cooler for pizza
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. Person in charge acquired thermometers and replaced them in coolers

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Live Animals Prohibited
violations.observation: Observed live animals on the premises of the establishment. Observed live animal during time of inspection. Observed a mice, travel from the employee/customer used bathroom behind the main kitchen area, across the back hallway, to under the 1 door chest freezer.
violations.corrective_action: Remove live animals from the premises. Live animals carry disease-causing organisms and can transmit pathogens to people through direct or indirect contamination of food and food-contact surfaces. Person in charge contacted pest control EHS will follow up tommorrow to verify compliance

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions. Person in charge is using bleach based sanitizer without having a test kit available to verify concentration
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a @BLEACH, QUATERNARY AMMONIA, IODINE@ test kit. Person in charge agreed to acquire a test kit, will verify compliance tomorrow. NEW YORK PIZZA FACTORY (Inspection Date: 10/09/2025) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Plumbing installed, proper backflow devices

violations.title: Plumbing System, Design/Install per Law
violations.observation: The plumbing system serving this food service facility has not been designed, constructed, and installed according to the Plumbing Code. Mop sink spigot has been replaced with a household Garden hose
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be designed, constructed, and installed according to Law. Person in charge agreed to have the mop sink spigot replaced .

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Plumbing connections under the 3 compartment sink sanitize basin is leaking
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. Person in charge agreed to have the 3 compartment sink leak repaired

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed that the @Physical structure@ is not maintained in good repair. Lights are burned out the greasehood above the pizza oven
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. Person in charge agreed to have the lights replaced in the greasehood

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the @Physical structure@ in the @Location@ is in need of cleaning. Kitchen floors and walls and cieling were in need of cleaning
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. Person in charge agreed to clean facility

out_items.name: Adequate ventilation and lighting, designated areas used

violations.title: Dressing Rooms, Designation
violations.observation: Dressing rooms/areas are not designated for employees who routinely change their clothes in the establishment. Employees personal item storage was located. Above food contact surfaces
violations.corrective_action: Provide separate dressing rooms for employees who routinely change their clothes at work to prevent contamination of food, food equipment, and food contact surfaces. Person in charge moved employees items away from food contact surfaces

out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Plan & Specifications Submission - Remodeling, Change of Type, Change of Operation
violations.observation: The permit holder did not submit plans or specifications for remodeling/renovation, change in type of establishment leading to extensive menu change, and/or change in layout/equipment.
violations.corrective_action: The permit applicant needs to submit the following documents to the Health Department for review and approval: plans Submit an amendment application to include plans showing proposed changes.

out_items.name: Certified Food Protection Manager

violations.title: Food Manager Certificate & Responsibility
violations.observation: There is no Certified Food Manager present at the beginning of the inspection.
violations.corrective_action: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager. It is highly suggested that you have more than one employee with the food manager's license. ORS Interactive, Inc. (see handout provided) issues the required photo identification card with proof of successful completion of a certified food manager's exam. Failure to have a certified food manager on site during ALL hours of operation including food preparation, food service, and cleaning/sanitizing of equipment/utensils will result in closure of the establishment. CFM arrived later during inspection.

out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: A food employee was observed eating in areas where they may contaminate food, clean equipment, utensils or other items needing protection.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may only eat, drink, or use tobacco in a designated area like a dining room or office area. Employees shall not eat or drink in the kitchen areas, warewashing areas, or storage areas where items may become contaminated. Employee discarded food and reviewed with EHS about proper eating and drinking procedures when handling food

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at handwashing sink in kitchen
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. PIC replaced paper towels.

out_items.name: Food properly labeled, original container

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: EHS observed working containers of semolina, mayo, bbq sauce, hot sauce, pizza sauce with common name labels
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. PIC agreed to make labels for working containers of food

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Miscellaneous Source Contamination
violations.observation: EHS observed dry storage area next to customer bathroom with no physical separation such as a wall or door.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination that may result from a factor or source not specified under Subparts 3-301 through 3-306. PIC agreed to separate and protect dry storage from customer use bathroom. NEW YORK PIZZA FACTORY (Inspection Date: 04/18/2025) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: EHS observed damp wiping clothes being stored on the pizza oven, not in sanitizer solution
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses.PIC moved wiping clothes to sanitizer solution

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: Manufacturer containers were observed reused, originally paprika container, being used to store salt.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. PIC disposed of container agreed to reuse manufacturer single use containers

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions, quaternary ammonia.
violations.corrective_action: PIC obtained a test kit for quaternary ammonia during inspection.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Floors/Walls/Ceilings, Smooth, Easily Cleanable
violations.observation: EHS observed door way to rear dry storage space is not smooth or easily cleanable.
violations.corrective_action: Floor, floor covering, walls, wall covering, and ceiling must be designed, constructed and installed to be smooth and easily cleanable. PIC shall provide finish schedule with the amendment submission.
